children: Cheetah Net Supply Chain Service entered into a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to acquire all issued and outstanding interests of JoyPak Supply for $788,000. The consideration includes an $88,000 initial payment within two business days of signing and $700,000 due within two business days after closing, expected on or about October 15, 2026. Upon closing, JoyPak will become a wholly owned subsidiary, enhancing Cheetah Net’s consumer and personal care product offerings.
